main_text.p: qua magná ànimi lenitate & gaudio Deo patri castiganti subijciuntur fideles. Iacob. 1.2.3. Hebr. 12.9.
Fructus perceptio specialis est vt coram Deo humiliati & contriti, prædictum pacis & sanctimoniæ fructum consequantur. Ex præced.
Atq; hæc de mediorum augmentis: Noua sequuntur.
main_text.l: Deo à nobis ex ipsius voluntate reddenda.
main_text.p: Sors est medium à Deo constitutum, quo ip-De forte. cap.6.se controuersias, quæ aliter ab hominibus dirimi non possunt, componit. Pro.16.33. & 18.18.Num.26.55.Iof.14.2.Leu.16.8.
Ad hanc præparatio quæ requiritur, est vt ex huius necessitatis sensu, Deum in hoc medio adea- mus.Pro.16.33.
{i}Adiuncta dispositio,est vt precibus ad deū peractis ab ipsius nuto pendeamus.Act.1.24.25.26.
Fructus est,vt animo pacato & iucundo in dei iudicio acquiescamus.Pro.18.18.
Sacer thesaurus, qui Deo vsibusq; sacris, consecra-De sacro thesauro. tus est.Pro.3.9.Act.2.42.Huius cap.7.

page.notes: The right margin note "De forte." at the top of the page stands beside the first line; it is placed at the start of the first paragraph. The diagram label "Sunt autem" is set beside a brace grouping two boxes. The second part of the page is cut off and is not transcribed here. Marginal notes on the right: "De sacro thesauro." and "Huius cap.7."; the brace marks beside the two alternatives are not transcribed as text. Some words are uncertain in the scan.
